title: Video Private Downloader
summary: Video Private Downloader is a powerful video downloader
description:
Video Private Downloader is a powerful video downloader that helps you quickly play and save video content from public domain and royalty-free resources.

Main Features:

- Supports common video formats: MP4, AVI, MKV, etc.

- Downloads are only allowed if the website or resource explicitly provides a download license.

Important Notes:

- This application does not support obtaining videos from YouTube or any platform that prohibits external downloads.

- Only works on websites that own royalty-free content or have obtained download licenses.

- Users are responsible for complying with relevant copyright terms and user agreements.

We will continue to optimize this application. Please leave a message with any suggestions or feedback, and we will follow up and make improvements.
